name: Brentwood
description: Sell your broken supercar in Brentwood. Gearbox faults, engine problems and non-runners considered, with specialist valuations and free collection by arrangement.
hero: A supercar that starts but will not select a gear can still be considered for purchase. Tell us about your faulty car in Brentwood for a specialist valuation and free collection once arrangements are agreed.
introTitle: The engine can run while the car remains undriveable
intro: A gearbox warning, clutch problem or loss of drive can leave a supercar parked despite an engine that appears to run normally. Describe what the car actually does when you enquire from Brentwood, rather than using only the label non-runner.

We consider transmission faults alongside engine, electrical, suspension and accident-damage enquiries. Include the precise model, mileage and maintenance record, and share any specialist findings. Tell us whether a repair has been attempted and if parts have been removed.

The sale and collection are discussed with our Medway-based team. A car at a Brentwood workshop may need different release arrangements from one in a private garage in Shenfield or Hutton; use the address where it currently stands.
collectionTitle: Tell us what happens when the car is put in gear
collectionIntro: The condition of the drivetrain affects both the assessment and the equipment needed for recovery. Do not assume a running engine means the car can be driven onto transport.

collection.title: Neutral and parking brake
collection.body: Explain whether neutral can be selected and the parking brake released. Tell us if these functions depend on a battery that is flat or unreliable.

collection.title: Wheels and movement
collection.body: Mention a wheel that locks, a dragging brake or any known drivetrain damage. State whether the car rolls freely without asking anyone to force it into motion.

collection.title: Where recovery can reach
collection.body: Give entrance details, available loading space and workshop opening hours where relevant. A narrow drive or enclosed garage needs to be considered before a slot is agreed.

coverageIntro: We welcome enquiries from Brentwood and nearby locations. Share the full postcode and the car’s current condition so collection can be discussed.

areas.title: Brentwood and Warley
areas.body: Homes, private garages and workshop locations in Brentwood and the Warley area.

areas.title: Shenfield and Hutton
areas.body: Enquiries from Shenfield, Hutton and surrounding addresses are welcome. The exact location and access determine the collection plan.

preparation.title: The symptom
preparation.body: Tell us whether the car will not select a gear, loses drive, shifts harshly or displays a warning. Include when the symptoms began and whether they are constant.

preparation.title: The investigation
preparation.body: Share the diagnostic report and any repair estimate. Separate a confirmed component failure from possible causes the workshop has not yet ruled out.

preparation.title: The vehicle around the fault
preparation.body: Provide mileage, specification and service history, plus other known issues. The buyer assesses the whole vehicle rather than the transmission in isolation.

closing: Send the details of your Brentwood supercar and the symptoms you have noticed. We’ll review the enquiry and discuss a possible offer and collection without requiring the car to drive.

faqs.question: Can I sell a supercar that starts but will not select a gear?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can enquire in that condition. Describe gear selection, warning messages and whether neutral and the parking brake work. Include any diagnostic information you already have.

faqs.question: Do you cover Shenfield and Hutton?
faqs.answer: Yes. We welcome enquiries from Shenfield, Hutton, Warley and the wider Brentwood area. Use the postcode where the car is actually kept.

faqs.question: Do I need to make the car roll before collection?
faqs.answer: Tell us if it does not roll freely so suitable recovery can be discussed. Do not assume a brake or transmission problem has to be repaired first; the collection plan depends on the details.

research.finding: Search results cover general non-runner removal and a classic-car specialist, rather than proving no competition. Content concentrates on transmission symptoms and recovery readiness. Council geography supports Shenfield, Hutton and Warley.
